# `csharp_wrap_before_arrow_with_expressions`

When an expression body wraps, put => at the start of the new line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }

    public string Describe()
    {
        return $"Widget({Value})";
    }
}
```

### `csharp_wrap_before_arrow_with_expressions = true`

```ini
csharp_wrap_before_arrow_with_expressions = true
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `csharp_wrap_before_arrow_with_expressions = false`

```ini
csharp_wrap_before_arrow_with_expressions = false
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
